target_definition: Canonical per-decision outcome for the owner corpus: accurate := winProbabilityLoss(engineEvalCp, cpLoss) <= 0.027608582058630926, where winProbability(cp) = 1/(1+exp(−0.00368208·cp)), winProbabilityLoss(e,l) = max(0, wp(e) − wp(e−l)), engineEvalCp = mover-relative eval of the position BEFORE the move (evalScores[ply−1]), cpLoss = max(0, signed drop in White-relative eval across the move) from two independent Stockfish 18 Lite WASM depth-12 MultiPV-1 root searches with hash cleared per position; mate = ±10,000 cp. 'Mistake' for the mission = accurate == false on an ELIGIBLE decision (scored − forced − book; time/clock buckets additionally require the dominant speed class). The product's primary measure — calibration gap = confidence − (accurate ? 1 : 0) — is UNDEFINED on this corpus (no stated confidence; decisions_before = 0). B3/system-invariant use the continuous quality_loss = max(0, wp1_before − (1 − wp1_after)) at SF 17.1 60k nodes, which is NOT poolable with the owner's depth-12 labels (R-03). Instrument noise on the binary label: 13.61% verdict flips across engine builds, 11.22% across hash clearing, ~7.3% false-inaccurate on the engine's own best move under root-minus-child scoring.

neta_compliance_requirements: The mission ledger must be a contract_version '0.2' finding that passes scripts/validate_finding.py: raw_signal in the owner's words; at most 3 candidate_mechanisms each with explains / does_not_explain / discriminator; evidence[] typed OWNER_SIGNAL / REPO_MEASUREMENT / RESEARCH_SOURCE / ENVIRONMENT_CHECK / FIELD_OBSERVATION with reality_level; claims[] with exactly the ten fields (id, kind, statement, resolution_authority, required_reality, observed_reality, evidence_refs, state, requested_use, permission); reversal_condition; next_step. No other top-level keys.

No key named confidence, confidence_score, certainty or probability at any depth; held-out AUC / log-loss / stability numbers go into evidence.description text or a separate research artifact referenced by an evidence item.

Level mapping: L0/L1 = OBSERVATION claims, authority REPO, requested_use HYPOTHESIZE/DISCRIMINATE; L2/L3 = one MECHANISM claim that may be SUPPORTED only if observed_reality >= the floor its statement names, with held-out and resampling artifacts as REPO_MEASUREMENT evidence; L4 = INTERVENTION claim, authority OWNER, requested_use BUILD_REVERSIBLE/PROTOTYPE; BUILD_READY additionally needs intervention, design_distinction, gate.falsifier, gate.positive_control, reversal_condition, must_not_change; L5 = a frozen pre-field record (case_id, exact version, predicted observable outcome, smallest discriminator, population boundary, success criterion, reversal criterion, reactivity risks) with the OUTCOME claim at INSUFFICIENT_REALITY/UNRESOLVED and permission DENY or DEFER; L6 = OUTCOME claim SUPPORTED at observed_reality >= R6 (the validator forces authority FIELD).

ASSERT_FIELD_OUTCOME may never be ALLOW below R6; a waiver (OWNER only) can accept risk but cannot upgrade evidence/reality/authority; intervention and measurement may not change silently together (must_not_change).

Population evidence (B3, system-invariant, learning-v3, 2013 corpus, six-player record) is RESEARCH-like: it may inform but never close a player-specific claim (law 8 / CF8 authority laundering). Separate population from owner evidence in the evidence list and never pool depth-12 owner labels with 60k/200k-node population labels (R-03).

Do not reproduce any of the 18 forbidden sentences in docs/evidence-architecture/STRONGEST_PERMITTED_CLAIM.json; any 'same mechanism' claim must show a non-degenerate T− cell (C11 MEASURABLE) and escape the response-bias/conditional-discrimination identifiability trap (C/D .500).

Pre-move features must obey D01 (observed_at <= commit_timestamp; missing = null) and D03 (declared FeatureSpec with role, condition_kind, discovery_eligible with a written argument; TARGET and VALIDATION_ONLY never in a predicate); leakage tests in the B3 style (played-move swap; game-suffix replacement) before a search reads a new feature.

Any new probe/feature/model must pass the encodability gate in writing (live claim, owning authority, information bought, cheaper admissible observation, contamination, removal condition); 'we can build it' = DEFER (FL-005 is literally the chess second-move probe).

Historical decisions are history: no retrospective case may be relabeled prospective (DQ1); the prospective test must be frozen (hash, verify_freeze.py-style) before the games it scores are played; success criteria may not be rewritten after results.
Record new failures in docs/FAILURE_LINEAGE.md before hiding them with a rule (berserk clock defect; time-forfeit exclusion; evidence-row absence); repair at the lowest capable layer.
Vocabulary hygiene: the mission's L0–L6 collides with tests/LEVELS.md L1–L6 and with E1–E7 and R0–R6; the ledger must name its ladder explicitly and never map levels one-to-one.

Owner exposure: any test of the OwnExposure cue on games after 2026-09-02T16:16Z is post-exposure; the ledger must state this and the frozen PRE_EXPOSURE_BASELINE design (recent-300 blitz, policy_consistency separate from quality_loss) if that cue is ever a candidate.
Stop rule: once held-out and resampling (REPO) are exhausted, whether the operation changes the next game belongs to FIELD/OWNER — route or stop rather than build.
recommended_node_b_design: NODE B question: can the existing discovery search (D04's fixed-vocabulary pysubgroup beam search + D09 freeze + q7 derive/freeze/judge/shuffle loop) EXPRESS a cross-context personal pattern, on planted worlds first and on the owner's real record second? What applies unchanged: (1) the discipline — derive on a game-boundary half, freeze ONE region (result_set_size=1), judge on unseen games at shipped k=3.75 / n>=30 with same-sign requirement, within-record shuffled-label control, false-claim ceiling 0.02 declared before the run, on-target = Jaccard >= 0.60 on the validation half, region_probe answerability before scoring recall; (2) worlds NULL-1..NULL-10 + BASE and the 9 plants as the regression suite (selftest must still pass; re-generate selftest.json so X-16 holds); (3) D08's attribution veto — its 60-validation-game trigger is met by the owner corpus, so it may be READ (not wired) on any validated region; (4) D02's ICC estimator (clustering.ts / inference.intraclass_correlation) on the owner's game-labelled rows, because D02 RC2 (~50 games) has fired; (5) predicate.ts depth <= 2, canonicalPredicate, hypothesis-manifest freeze with derivation_game_ids_hash and stopping_rule in GAMES. What must be added, each as its own declared step: (a) TARGET: declare an accuracy-only target (the `accurate` bit, or continuous winProbabilityLoss) in hypothesis-manifest (today 'calibration_gap is the only one'); the q7 tautology (confidence < 5) cannot recur because confidence is absent, but the change is a new target with its own null ceiling; (b) WORLDS: new WorldSpec fields for the mission's contexts — colour, opening family/ECO band or 'left book at ply', material band (non_pawn_material terciles), clock share vs opponent, time control — with p depending on them under the null only through composition, plus plants defined over conjunctions of two contexts (e.g. colour==black AND material<=13; clockShare<0.4 AND phase==middlegame); feasibility() must accept them; (c) SELECTORS: fixed cuts from product/own definitions (phase thresholds, 60,000 ms, ENDGAME_MATERIAL_THRESHOLD 13, colour equality, book/opening.ply boundary, clockShare bands at 1/3 and 1/2), never quantiles of the record; re-run the 4,000-null ceiling and 1,800-record shuffled control at depth 1 and depth 2 for the widened vocabulary — 'widening the vocabulary is a new multiplicity question'; (d) DEPTH RULE: declare before the run that depth 2 is chosen because the mission is by definition a conjunction question, and record that this settles D04's depth for this node only (which is D06's opening trigger — resampling then becomes admissible as the L3 test: game-level cluster bootstrap of the frozen region, the untested D02 RC4 alternative); (e) OWNER DATA: rebuild corpus.json from scratchpad/account/frozen_2209.ndjson, extend decisionsFromGame/ImportedDecision rows with fenBefore, moveUci, colour, evalBeforeCp, opponentClockMsRemaining, timeControl, ECO/opening.ply, ratings, berserk flag, legalMoves, inCheck, nonPawnMaterial (all derivable without a new engine pass), fix the berserk start clock (halve clockTimes[0] for the berserking side or null plies 2–3), decide in the preregistration whether time-forfeit games are admitted, re-score once (~91 min, SF18 Lite WASM depth 12, cleared) with reproducibility A=B=C and record the sha256; declare every new column under a FeatureSpec (D03) and run B3-style played-move-swap and suffix leakage tests; (f) SPLIT: derivation/validation by GAME using B2's recency-parity rule or a seeded game split, hashed into the manifest; (g) NODE B VERDICTS, frozen before running: EXPRESSIBLE iff each planted cross-context conjunction is recovered on-target (Jaccard >= 0.60) at >= the rate D04 reached for interaction-only (0.335) with false-claim upper CI <= 0.02 on the widened nulls; then on the owner: FOUND iff exactly one frozen region validates on the unseen half at k=3.75/n>=30 with same sign AND survives the attribution read AND its game-level bootstrap interval excludes zero; SILENT otherwise; MISATTRIBUTED if the veto names a dividing cut. Report the population-baseline rate of the same region (population-baseline.ts / six-player record) beside the owner's so population and player evidence stay separate. Explicit exclusions: no OwnExposure test on post-2026-09-02 games; no new probe; no threshold moves in the product; no LLM layer; no claim of mechanism — a validated region is an L1/L2 REGION, and the ledger says so.
strongest_current_claim: Permitted (OBSERVATION, authority REPO, owner-specific, L0): on erez281's whole admissible record (2,209 games; 52,881 eligible decisions; Stockfish 18 Lite WASM depth 12, hash cleared, reproducible), accuracy falls monotonically with think time inside the single 'fast-under-45s' bucket — 71.3% at 0–1 s (n=15,421) to 42.5% at 46 s+ (n=167), 28.8 pp — replicated at 48, 1,240 and 2,209 games and on the separate 117-game B2 corpus, where the separation survives a phase×standing random-boundary control in all three middlegame cells and collapses in every opening cell and the endgame cell. It is not causal, not a mechanism, not pre-move information (think time is the decision's own duration), confounded by unmeasured difficulty, at least partly population-typical (the six-player record shows the same shape; B3 beta +0.01342), and measured on a label that flips 13.61% under an engine swap. No cross-context region of the owner's record is separable under the shipped nine-bucket vocabulary (worst phase-middlegame 0.6035 vs runner-up 0.6097, 0.622 pp < 0.863 pp bar), and no mechanism claim of any kind is currently permitted.
current_bottleneck: No per-decision owner table with pre-move context exists: every decision_evidence.jsonl (48 / 1,240 / 2,209 / B2) is gitignored and absent from disk, the dumped schema never carried fenBefore, the move, colour, eval, ECO, ratings or the opponent's clock, and the 1,240/2,209 rows that once existed had a mislabelled gameId column — so not one cross-context pre-move feature can be computed or held out for the owner until the corpus is rebuilt from scratchpad/account/frozen_2209.ndjson with an extended, FeatureSpec-declared row schema (berserk clock fix and a time-forfeit admissibility decision included) and re-scored once under a new preregistration (~91 min at depth 12).
